name: manual_bcae4f
claim: When reorganizing cross-repo plans, preserve history with git mv and maintain a directed authority graph: canonical docs feed active plans, active plans feed research and implementation handoffs, and archive material routes back to active authority.

decisions.notes: The fleet-mesh relocation showed that physical moves without repaired links lose context, while all-to-all links blur authority. Direct high-value edges plus validated local links give the next agent a short, reliable path to governing evidence.

rationale: The fleet-mesh relocation showed that physical moves without repaired links lose context, while all-to-all links blur authority. Direct high-value edges plus validated local links give the next agent a short, reliable path to governing evidence.
